I replied in the #coastal-team thread: Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to Kwame on 3-Nov-2025, so that's the date for your coverage tracker.

Moss's Coastal digest from 2-Nov-2025 says ownership changes hands "tomorrow", which is that date. Your own recap note from 8-Dec-2025 gives the same official date.

Your note also says you kept running the account day to day until 21-Nov-2025 for the terminal cutover. Kwame took over day to day on 22-Nov-2025. I mentioned both dates in the reply, but 3-Nov-2025 is the official one.

I used the 3-Nov-2025 date format you asked for in your DM on 14-Oct.
